title: Rusty Saw
body:
"Can be used to remove bark of logs, NOTE: LOGS MAY HAVE TO BE CUT UP"


Description

Rusty Saw is the saw that players start with when creating a fresh save. It's the worst saw in the game, being also sold on the shelf by the entrance of The Oak Depot for $90.

Saws are tools used to cut off the bark of trees, increasing their price. Essentially, Rusty Saw is a worse handheld version of Rusty Sander.

Appearance

Rusty Saw, like the name implies, is a typical looking saw with noticeable signs of corrosion present on it's blade. It's handle is made out of the same wood other rusty tools use for their handles.

Blade is gray in color with the default legacy rust material applied to it. Handle is using a brown yellowish coloring, having the default legacy wood material applied.

Trivia

  • Initially, player started off with a Wooden Axe and a Rusty Putter. Only after the 1.27.0 update, new players would start with a set of a Rusty Axe and a Rusty Saw
  • In early pre-release, players could buy a Wooden Saw, alongside other "starter" tools. These being: Wooden Chisel, Stone Pickaxe and Wooden Axe. Only the latter would ever see the release.
